paper_id: Neural network fragile watermarking with no model performance degradation
title: Neural network fragile watermarking with no model performance degradation
motivation: Pre-trained DNN models may be injected with backdoors through malicious finetuning, risking security in applications like autonomous driving.
problem_framing: Fragile watermarking to detect model modification: watermarks should be sensitive to fine-tuning so any modification is immediately detectable.
key_insight: Using variance regularization on prediction probabilities across categories makes generated triggers sensitive to model parameter changes.
method_signature: Train generative model with L_cla + a·Var(P) loss to create fragile triggers without modifying target classifier.
evaluation_criteria: AccTri measures difference between predicted labels and secret key; AccTri<1.0 indicates model modification.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: When weight a=1, AccTri does not decline in first epoch—detection may have omissions.
thinking_moves: 把检测模型完整性问题reframe成通信验证问题
通过Ablation study验证Var正则项是生成脆弱触发的关键
对比白盒和黑盒方法的局限性，突出无需模型细节的黑盒方案
